metas.name: Possible Love
metas.description: A laid-off worker and his wife cross paths with a documentary filmmaker and her spouse and confront their hidden desires.

metas.name: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
metas.description: Harry Lehman is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. metas.name: Fatherland
metas.description: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.

metas.name: Gentle Monster
metas.description: After relocating with her family to the countryside, a renowned pianist uncovers a life-shattering truth that forces her to confront the complexities of love, trust, and deception.

metas.name: Trauma or, Monsters All
metas.description: An aspiring author gets more than she bargained for when she writes an article for the local paper about her small town’s dark history, prompting unwanted speculation on what monsters may lie within.

metas.name: Littermates
metas.description: Amidst the chaos of a mysterious war, two victims of an attack take refuge at a cottage in the English countryside, where an enigmatic caretaker insists they cannot leave.

metas.name: New Group
metas.description: Ai is a high school girl who feels suffocated by social pressure, but finds it hard to fight going with the flow. metas.name: A Talent for Murder
metas.description: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

metas.name: Resident Evil
metas.description: Follows a hapless courier tasked with delivering a package to a remote hospital. He soon finds himself caught in the middle of an outbreak and must fight through hordes of mutated creatures to survive.

metas.name: Making Marie Antoinette
metas.description: Eleanor Coppola's behind-the-scenes documentation of her daughter Sofia Coppola directing the 2006 film Marie Antoinette, capturing the craftsmanship and challenges of being a young female director.

metas.name: Club Kid
metas.description: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.

metas.name: Primetime
metas.description: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history.

metas.name: Digger
metas.description: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

metas.name: Minding the Gap
metas.description: Filmmaker Bing Liu searches for correlations between his skateboarder friends' turbulent upbringings and the complexities of modern masculinity.

metas.name: Cry-Baby
metas.description: In 1950s Baltimore, a bad boy with a heart of gold wins the love of a good girl, whose boyfriend sets out for revenge.

metas.name: The Holdovers
metas.description: In 1970, a curmudgeonly history teacher at a New England boarding school remains on campus during Christmas break to supervise held over students, and ends up forming an unlikely bond with a brainy but damaged troublemaker.

metas.name: Children of Men
metas.description: In 2027, in a chaotic world in which women have somehow become infertile, a former activist agrees to help transport a miraculously pregnant woman to a sanctuary at sea.

metas.name: Janet Planet
metas.description: In rural Western Massachusetts, 11-year-old Lacy spends the summer of 1991 at home, enthralled by her own imagination and the attention of her mother, Janet. As the months pass, three visitors enter their orbit, all captivated by ...

metas.name: Red Rocket
metas.description: Washed-up porn star Mikey Saber returns to his small Texas hometown and decides if he wants to be with his ex-wife or the donut shop girl hes in love with.

metas.name: Peppermint Candy
metas.description: Following a man's suicide, time traverses back to reveal six chapters of his life on why he committed suicide.

metas.name: Cure
metas.description: A frustrated detective deals with the case of several gruesome murders committed by people who have no recollection of what they've done.

metas.name: Raw
metas.description: A young woman, studying to be a vet, develops a craving for human flesh.

metas.name: God's Own Country
metas.description: Spring. Yorkshire. Young farmer Johnny Saxby numbs his daily frustrations with binge drinking and casual sex, until the arrival of a Romanian migrant worker for lambing season ignites an intense relationship that sets Johnny on a ...

metas.name: But I'm a Cheerleader
metas.description: A naïve teenager is sent to "sexual redirection" school when her straitlaced parents and friends suspect her of being gay.

metas.name: The Wicker Man
metas.description: A puritan police sergeant arrives in a Scottish island village in search of a missing girl, who the pagan locals claim never existed.

metas.name: Hour of the Wolf
metas.description: While vacationing on a remote German island with his younger pregnant wife, an artist has an emotional breakdown while confronting his repressed desires.

metas.name: All About My Mother
metas.description: A comedy-drama about a bereaved mother, an overwrought actress, her jealous lover, and a pregnant nun.

metas.name: Wicker
metas.description: An ostracized fisherwoman commissions the local basketmaker to weave her a husband, but when her wicker creation proves unexpectedly extraordinary, his presence ignites jealousy and upheaval that threatens their quiet village.

metas.name: Soulm8te
metas.description: A man acquires an Artificially Intelligent android to cope with the loss of his recently deceased wife. In an attempt to create a truly sentient partner, he inadvertently turns a harmless lovebot into a deadly soulmate.

metas.name: Evil Dead Burn
metas.description: After the loss of her husband, a woman seeks solace with her in-laws. As one by one they transform into deadites, she comes to discover that the vows she took in life - survive even in death.

metas.name: Clayface
metas.description: Rising Hollywood star Matt Hagen descends into a horrifying revenge-filled monster when scientific ambition strips him of his identity and humanity.

metas.name: Whalefall
metas.description: Follows a scuba diver who, while looking for his father's remains, is swallowed by an 80-foot, 60-ton sperm whale and has just one hour to get out before his oxygen runs out.

metas.name: The Social Reckoning
metas.description: Follows Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, who enlisted the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to blow the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.

metas.name: Jane B. for Agnes V.
metas.description: "I'll look at you, but not at the camera. It could be a trap," whispers Jane Birkin shyly into Agnès Varda's ear at the start of JANE B. PAR AGNES V. The director of CLEO FROM 5 TO 7 and VAGABOND once again paints a portrait of a ...

metas.name: Pervert Park
metas.description: Pervert Park follows the everyday lives of the sex offenders in the park as they struggle to reintegrate into society.

metas.name: Taekwondo
metas.description: A man invites another guy he trains with to spend some time in his country house among other male friends.

metas.name: A Separation
metas.description: A married couple have to decide whether to improve their daughter's life by moving abroad or to stay in Iran and look after a deteriorating parent with Alzheimer's disease.

metas.name: All We Imagine as Light
metas.description: In Mumbai, Nurse Prabha's routine is troubled when she receives an unexpected gift from her estranged husband. Her younger roommate, Anu, tries in vain to find a spot in the city to be intimate with her boyfriend.

metas.name: Perfect Blue
metas.description: A pop singer gives up her career to become an actress, but she slowly goes insane when she starts being stalked by an obsessed fan and what seems to be a ghost of her past.

metas.name: The Holy Mountain
metas.description: In a corrupt, greed-fueled world, a powerful alchemist leads a messianic character and seven materialistic figures to the Holy Mountain, where they hope to achieve enlightenment.

metas.name: One Battle After Another
metas.description: When their enemy resurfaces after 16 years, a group of ex-revolutionaries reunite to rescue the daughter of one of their own.

metas.name: Streamers
metas.description: Four young soldiers waiting to be shipped to Viet Nam deal with racial tension and their own intolerance when one soldier reveals he's gay.

metas.name: Suspiria
metas.description: An American newcomer to a prestigious German ballet academy comes to realize that the school is a front for something sinister amid a series of grisly murders.

metas.name: Bonjour Tristesse
metas.description: Spoiled Cecile, 17, spends her summer at the French Riviera with her rich, widower, playboy dad and Elsa. Anne, her late mom's friend, visits and brings changes to all.

metas.name: American Honey
metas.description: A teenage girl with nothing to lose joins a traveling magazine sales crew, and gets caught up in a whirlwind of hard partying, law bending and young love as she criss-crosses the Midwest with a band of misfits.

metas.name: Mandy
metas.description: The enchanted lives of a couple in a secluded forest are brutally shattered by a nightmarish hippie cult and their demon-biker henchmen, propelling a man into a spiraling, surreal rampage of vengeance.

metas.name: Noroi
metas.description: A prominent paranormal journalist Kobayashi goes missing shortly after completing a documentary. What begins as an investigation into strange noises soon evolves into the chilling mystery of a demonic entity named Kagutaba.

metas.name: Leviathan
metas.description: A documentary shot in the North Atlantic and focused on the commercial fishing industry.

metas.name: Honeyland
metas.description: The last female bee-hunter in Europe must save the bees and return the natural balance in Honeyland, when a family of nomadic beekeepers invade her land and threaten her livelihood.

metas.name: Law of Desire
metas.description: A gay filmmaker becomes involved with an obsessive fan while still pining for his absent true love. Meanwhile, he shares a close but complex relationship with his trans sister, an actress.
